source: CTR data per airfield, given by the maintainer (2026-08). `clockStartsAt` names the CTR exit points: the clock starts on the leg LEAVING one, so the leg arriving at it is still inside. `inside` lists points inside the CTR that no published corridor traverses -- everything the corridors DO traverse between the field and an exit is derived from the route graph at load time and does not need listing here.
_note: A field absent from this list behaves as before -- the clock starts at the field. A listed field always excludes at least its first leg: you cannot be outside the CTR at the field itself.
